name: pi-agent-events-pydantic
description: Generate Pydantic v2 models for pi's AgentEvent stdout stream, pinned to a fixed pi version.
comment_versions: Pin these to the EXACT pi version whose stdout you want to parse. The sandbox image installs @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@<X>; pin these two to the same <X>. AgentEvent resolves entirely from these two packages.
